title: The Crack Under the Couch
notes: Per-line dialogue/timing manifest for Act 1. Voice is ElevenLabs TTS (eleven_multilingual_v2), generated on the FREE tier -- non-commercial, requires ElevenLabs attribution, NOT cleared to ship as-is (see project README). 45 of 49 lines are voiced -- the free-tier monthly quota ran out mid-batch. The 4 unvoiced lines are the generic fallback/transition lines (act01-046 through act01-049: use-item-on-scenery, examine-self, try-exit-lobby, and the Act 1->2 transition line) -- least critical to the core playable path (location, all hotspots, full Bramble tree, the toll-gate puzzle, and idle re-engagement are all voiced). Regenerate the remaining 4 once quota allows, same line_ids, no code changes needed.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Whoa— okay. Okay! That is a lot of down there is now up there. Or, I'm just really small. One of those.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Right. Marble. Find marble. Then never mention any of this to anyone, ever.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: The underside of the couch. Staples, a tag that says 'DO NOT REMOVE UNDER PENALTY OF LAW,' and something that might be a Cheeto from a previous administration.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: A dust clump. The good kind. The kind that's hiding something.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Dust Clump / search, reveals button
lines.text: Ooh, a button! Bet that's worth something down here.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Dust Clump / search after button taken
lines.text: Just dust now. Respectfully, dust.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: A whole wall of cubbies. The Lost and Underfound, official archive.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Cubby four: one earring, shaped like a question mark. Still waiting on its pair.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Cubby seven: a dead watch battery, labeled 'MIGHT STILL WORK.' It's been three years.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Cubby twelve: a single Lego. The most dangerous object in this entire building, respected accordingly.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Sign-In Log / examine (foreshadowing, no mechanic yet)
lines.text: A sign-in log. Everyone who's come through today... huh. Somebody signed in carrying something 'round and shiny.' That's not nothing.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: A popcorn kernel. The size of my head. This explains so much about Tuesdays in this house.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Popcorn Kernel Boulder / use, permanent flavor fail
lines.text: Nope. Not budging. I respect its commitment.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: A cobweb curtain, and a tunnel behind it. Tiny tunnel. Extremely not-Pip-sized tunnel.

lines.speaker: SCUTTLE
lines.context: Sec 1, Cobweb Curtain / Scuttle cameo, non-interactive, plays once
lines.text: 'Scuse! Coming through! Delivery! No time, no time—

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Cobweb Curtain / Pip reaction to Scuttle
lines.text: ...okay then.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: Oh! A visitor. A big one. Well, big for here. Do you have an appointment, a claim ticket, or a very good reason?

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: None of those. I'm looking for a marble. It rolled under here like ten minutes ago.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: A marble! Round, shiny, catastrophically easy to lose. Very common. Very popular around here, actually.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: ...popular how?

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: Nothing! Nothing to worry about! Let's get you processed.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: Now, you'll want to look at things. Closely. And touch things, when appropriate. And occasionally put two things together, when the universe allows it.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: That's just... how I already do things.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: Wonderful! You're a natural claimant.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: Your marble likely rolled through the Grate. Everything shiny does, eventually.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Great! I'll just—

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: The Grate is guarded. By Old Bottlecap. Who does not open for just anyone.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: What does he open for?

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: A toll. He's very serious about the toll. It's the only thing he's serious about, other than being disappointed in everyone.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Any tips on what the toll actually is?

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: Something small. Something round. Something you'll probably find lying around, if you look in the sort of place nobody looks.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: Me? Self-appointed Lost and Underfound Clerk, three years running. Someone has to file things. I have chosen to be that someone.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Nobody made you do this?

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: Nobody had to. That's the tragedy.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: Old Bottlecap predates the filing system. Predates me, probably. Predates the couch, if you ask him, though I wouldn't recommend asking him things.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: That's not really a form, is it. That's just, a thing you're holding at me.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: The Grate. And someone very old, very round, and very unimpressed, sitting right in front of it.

lines.speaker: OLD_BOTTLECAP
lines.context: Sec 3, Use wrong item / nothing on gate, fail
lines.text: No toll, no through. Come back when you've got something worth my time.

lines.speaker: OLD_BOTTLECAP
lines.context: Sec 3, Use Button on gate, success part 1
lines.text: ...a button. Acceptable. Barely.

lines.speaker: OLD_BOTTLECAP
lines.context: Sec 3, Use Button on gate, success part 2
lines.text: Fine. Go on. Try not to get lost. It'd be embarrassing for both of us.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: It's the Lost and Underfound, isn't it, that's kind of the whole—

lines.speaker: OLD_BOTTLECAP
lines.text: Go.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 4, Idle / re-examine gate after opened
lines.text: Open now. He's still glaring, though. I think that's just his face.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 4, Idle / talk to Bramble post-gate
lines.text: Made it past the Grate.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.text: Already? I'm almost disappointed. I had a whole speech prepared.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 4, Fallback / use item on scenery
lines.text: That's not going to help. Probably. Let's not test it.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Same shirt as this morning. Considerably smaller than this morning.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 4, Fallback / try to leave before gate opened
lines.text: Not done here. There's a marble with my name on it. Metaphorically. It's just a marble.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Okay. Underneath, for real now. Marble, here I come.
